learn.title: Passive Voice – Other Tenses
objectives_vi: Nhận diện và hiểu các cấu trúc trong bài Passive Voice – Other Tenses.
Chọn cấu trúc đúng theo dấu hiệu ngữ cảnh, không học thuộc từ đơn lẻ.
Phát hiện và sửa những lỗi thường gặp ở các dạng Guided, Independent và Mastery.

rules.heading: Past Perfect Passive
rules.explanation_vi: Past perfect passive: had been + V3, before another past event.

examples.en: By the time the guests arrived, excavation findings had been documented by the archaeologist.
examples.vi: Trước khi khách đến, các phát hiện khai quật đã được nhà khảo cổ ghi chép.

common_mistake.wrong: By the time the guests arrived, excavation findings has been documented by the archaeologist.
common_mistake.correct: By the time the guests arrived, excavation findings had been documented by the archaeologist.
common_mistake.why_vi: Past perfect passive: had been + V3, before another past event.

rules.heading: Future Perfect Passive
rules.explanation_vi: Future perfect passive: will have been + V3 for completion before a future point.

examples.en: By this time next Friday, student meetings will have been scheduled by the baker.
examples.vi: Đến giờ này thứ Sáu tuần tới, các buổi gặp học sinh sẽ đã được chuyên viên tư vấn học đường xếp lịch xong.

common_mistake.wrong: By this time next Friday, student meetings will have scheduled by the baker.
common_mistake.correct: By this time next Friday, student meetings will have been scheduled by the baker.
common_mistake.why_vi: Future perfect passive: will have been + V3 for completion before a future point.

rules.heading: Modal Passive
rules.explanation_vi: Modal passive = modal + be + V3.

examples.en: The supervisor insists that basic first-aid techniques must be demonstrated before the doors open.
examples.vi: Người giám sát yêu cầu các kỹ thuật sơ cứu cơ bản phải được hướng dẫn trước khi mở cửa.

common_mistake.wrong: The supervisor insists that basic first-aid techniques must demonstrated before the doors open.
common_mistake.correct: The supervisor insists that basic first-aid techniques must be demonstrated before the doors open.
common_mistake.why_vi: Modal passive = modal + be + V3.

rules.heading: Present Cont Passive
rules.explanation_vi: Present continuous passive = is/are being + V3.

examples.en: At the moment, the process of checking the new speakers is being closely monitored.
examples.vi: Hiện quá trình kiểm tra loa mới đang được giám sát chặt chẽ.

common_mistake.wrong: At the moment, the process of checking the new speakers was being closely monitored.
common_mistake.correct: At the moment, the process of checking the new speakers is being closely monitored.
common_mistake.why_vi: Present continuous passive = is/are being + V3.

rules.heading: Past Cont Passive
rules.explanation_vi: Past continuous passive = was/were being + V3.

examples.en: At 9 a.m. yesterday, the process of preparing school uniforms was being reviewed by the quality team.
examples.vi: Lúc 9 giờ sáng hôm qua, quá trình chuẩn bị đồng phục học sinh đang được nhóm chất lượng rà soát.

common_mistake.wrong: At 9 a.m. yesterday, the process of preparing school uniforms is being reviewed by the quality team.
common_mistake.correct: At 9 a.m. yesterday, the process of preparing school uniforms was being reviewed by the quality team.
common_mistake.why_vi: Past continuous passive = was/were being + V3.

rules.heading: Present Perfect Passive
rules.explanation_vi: Present perfect passive = has been + past participle for a present result.

examples.en: The supervisor confirms that the inspection of character sketches has already been completed, so no additional work is necessary.
examples.vi: Người giám sát xác nhận việc kiểm tra các bản phác họa nhân vật đã hoàn thành.

common_mistake.wrong: The supervisor confirms that the inspection of character sketches has already completed, so no additional work is necessary.
common_mistake.correct: The supervisor confirms that the inspection of character sketches has already been completed, so no additional work is necessary.
common_mistake.why_vi: Present perfect passive = has been + past participle for a present result.

rules.heading: Perfect Modal Passive
rules.explanation_vi: Perfect modal passive = modal + have been + V3; intended completion.

examples.en: Before the team leaves tomorrow, the vehicle brakes should have been checked.
examples.vi: Phanh xe dự kiến phải được kiểm tra xong trước khi nhóm rời đi ngày mai.

common_mistake.wrong: Before the team leaves tomorrow, the vehicle brakes should be checked.
common_mistake.correct: Before the team leaves tomorrow, the vehicle brakes should have been checked.
common_mistake.why_vi: Perfect modal passive = modal + have been + V3; intended completion.

rules.heading: Future Simple Passive
rules.explanation_vi: Future simple passive = will be + V3.

examples.en: The director says medical supplies will be carried during tomorrow’s shift.
examples.vi: Vật tư y tế sẽ được mang trong ca làm ngày mai.

common_mistake.wrong: The director says medical supplies will carried during tomorrow’s shift.
common_mistake.correct: The director says medical supplies will be carried during tomorrow’s shift.
common_mistake.why_vi: Future simple passive = will be + V3.

misconceptions.wrong: By the time the guests arrived, excavation findings has been documented by the archaeologist.
misconceptions.correct: By the time the guests arrived, excavation findings had been documented by the archaeologist.
misconceptions.why_vi: Past perfect passive: had been + V3, before another past event.

misconceptions.wrong: By this time next Friday, student meetings will have scheduled by the baker.
misconceptions.correct: By this time next Friday, student meetings will have been scheduled by the baker.
misconceptions.why_vi: Future perfect passive: will have been + V3 for completion before a future point.

misconceptions.wrong: The supervisor insists that basic first-aid techniques must demonstrated before the doors open.
misconceptions.correct: The supervisor insists that basic first-aid techniques must be demonstrated before the doors open.
misconceptions.why_vi: Modal passive = modal + be + V3.

misconceptions.wrong: At the moment, the process of checking the new speakers was being closely monitored.
misconceptions.correct: At the moment, the process of checking the new speakers is being closely monitored.
misconceptions.why_vi: Present continuous passive = is/are being + V3.

misconceptions.wrong: At 9 a.m. yesterday, the process of preparing school uniforms is being reviewed by the quality team.
misconceptions.correct: At 9 a.m. yesterday, the process of preparing school uniforms was being reviewed by the quality team.
misconceptions.why_vi: Past continuous passive = was/were being + V3.

exception_notes_vi: Cẩn thận phân biệt bị động tiếp diễn (be being V3) và hoàn thành (have been V3).
Một số câu bị động dùng by + tác nhân; nếu không quan trọng có thể bỏ tác nhân.
Chỉ chấm một mục tiêu thì ở mỗi câu; tránh đưa hai mốc thời gian mâu thuẫn.
learning_steps_vi: Đọc quy tắc và ví dụ song ngữ, chỉ ra dấu hiệu quyết định đáp án.
Luyện 20 câu có phản hồi ngay.
Tự làm 30 câu không xem đáp án trước.
Làm 15 câu Mastery độc lập; dành 15 câu riêng cho Spaced Review.

learn.title: Passive Agents & Instruments
objectives_vi: Nhận diện và hiểu các cấu trúc trong bài Passive Agents & Instruments.
Chọn cấu trúc đúng theo dấu hiệu ngữ cảnh, không học thuộc từ đơn lẻ.
Phát hiện và sửa những lỗi thường gặp ở các dạng Guided, Independent và Mastery.

rules.heading: By Agent
rules.explanation_vi: By introduces the human agent in a passive clause.

examples.en: The paperwork for grammar rules was approved by the language tutor yesterday.
examples.vi: Hồ sơ về các quy tắc ngữ pháp đã được gia sư ngoại ngữ duyệt hôm qua.

common_mistake.wrong: The paperwork for grammar rules was approved with the language tutor yesterday.
common_mistake.correct: The paperwork for grammar rules was approved by the language tutor yesterday.
common_mistake.why_vi: By introduces the human agent in a passive clause.

rules.heading: With Tool
rules.explanation_vi: With identifies a tool or instrument.

examples.en: The workshop task involving building entrances was completed with a specially designed tool.
examples.vi: Nhiệm vụ về các lối vào tòa nhà được hoàn thành bằng một dụng cụ chuyên dụng.

common_mistake.wrong: The workshop task involving building entrances was completed by a specially designed tool.
common_mistake.correct: The workshop task involving building entrances was completed with a specially designed tool.
common_mistake.why_vi: With identifies a tool or instrument.

rules.heading: Signed By
rules.explanation_vi: Use by for the person who signs a document in the passive.

examples.en: The work order for parent newsletters was signed by Liam, who had authorization.
examples.vi: Lệnh công việc về bản tin cho phụ huynh được Liam ký.

common_mistake.wrong: The work order for parent newsletters was signed with Liam, who had authorization.
common_mistake.correct: The work order for parent newsletters was signed by Liam, who had authorization.
common_mistake.why_vi: Use by for the person who signs a document in the passive.

rules.heading: Camera With
rules.explanation_vi: Use with for an instrument used to take photographs.

examples.en: Photos of an interview article were taken with a digital camera rather than a phone.
examples.vi: Ảnh của một bài phỏng vấn được chụp bằng máy ảnh kỹ thuật số.

common_mistake.wrong: Photos of an interview article were taken by a digital camera rather than a phone.
common_mistake.correct: Photos of an interview article were taken with a digital camera rather than a phone.
common_mistake.why_vi: Use with for an instrument used to take photographs.

rules.heading: Repaired By
rules.explanation_vi: By identifies who carried out the repair.

examples.en: The equipment used to scan grocery items was repaired by a qualified technician.
examples.vi: Thiết bị dùng để quét mã các món hàng tạp hóa được kỹ thuật viên sửa chữa.

common_mistake.wrong: The equipment used to scan grocery items was repaired with a qualified technician.
common_mistake.correct: The equipment used to scan grocery items was repaired by a qualified technician.
common_mistake.why_vi: By identifies who carried out the repair.

rules.heading: Printer With
rules.explanation_vi: With introduces the device used for printing.

examples.en: The labels for city maps were printed with a label printer.
examples.vi: Nhãn cho bản đồ thành phố được in bằng máy in nhãn.

common_mistake.wrong: The labels for city maps were printed by a label printer.
common_mistake.correct: The labels for city maps were printed with a label printer.
common_mistake.why_vi: With introduces the device used for printing.

rules.heading: Display By
rules.explanation_vi: By + person/organization identifies the passive agent.

examples.en: The display featuring stretching exercises was prepared by the trainer for the exhibition.
examples.vi: Phần trưng bày về các bài giãn cơ được huấn luyện viên chuẩn bị.

common_mistake.wrong: The display featuring stretching exercises was prepared with the trainer for the exhibition.
common_mistake.correct: The display featuring stretching exercises was prepared by the trainer for the exhibition.
common_mistake.why_vi: By + person/organization identifies the passive agent.

rules.heading: Software With
rules.explanation_vi: With introduces software used as an instrument.

examples.en: The data about two document versions were recorded with spreadsheet software, not on paper.
examples.vi: Số đo về hai phiên bản tài liệu được ghi bằng phần mềm bảng tính.

common_mistake.wrong: The data about two document versions were recorded by spreadsheet software, not on paper.
common_mistake.correct: The data about two document versions were recorded with spreadsheet software, not on paper.
common_mistake.why_vi: With introduces software used as an instrument.

misconceptions.wrong: The paperwork for grammar rules was approved with the language tutor yesterday.
misconceptions.correct: The paperwork for grammar rules was approved by the language tutor yesterday.
misconceptions.why_vi: By introduces the human agent in a passive clause.

misconceptions.wrong: The workshop task involving building entrances was completed by a specially designed tool.
misconceptions.correct: The workshop task involving building entrances was completed with a specially designed tool.
misconceptions.why_vi: With identifies a tool or instrument.

misconceptions.wrong: The work order for parent newsletters was signed with Liam, who had authorization.
misconceptions.correct: The work order for parent newsletters was signed by Liam, who had authorization.
misconceptions.why_vi: Use by for the person who signs a document in the passive.

misconceptions.wrong: Photos of an interview article were taken by a digital camera rather than a phone.
misconceptions.correct: Photos of an interview article were taken with a digital camera rather than a phone.
misconceptions.why_vi: Use with for an instrument used to take photographs.

misconceptions.wrong: The equipment used to scan grocery items was repaired with a qualified technician.
misconceptions.correct: The equipment used to scan grocery items was repaired by a qualified technician.
misconceptions.why_vi: By identifies who carried out the repair.

exception_notes_vi: By + tác nhân thực hiện hành động, with + dụng cụ/phương tiện.
Không phải mọi câu có with đều là câu bị động; cần nhận diện ngữ nghĩa.
Trong một số ngữ cảnh by có thể chỉ phương pháp (by train), không phải tác nhân.
learning_steps_vi: Đọc quy tắc và ví dụ song ngữ, chỉ ra dấu hiệu quyết định đáp án.
Luyện 20 câu có phản hồi ngay.
Tự làm 30 câu không xem đáp án trước.
Làm 15 câu Mastery độc lập; dành 15 câu riêng cho Spaced Review.

learn.title: Defining Relative Clauses
objectives_vi: Nhận diện và hiểu các cấu trúc trong bài Defining Relative Clauses.
Chọn cấu trúc đúng theo dấu hiệu ngữ cảnh, không học thuộc từ đơn lẻ.
Phát hiện và sửa những lỗi thường gặp ở các dạng Guided, Independent và Mastery.

rules.heading: Rel Person
rules.explanation_vi: Who introduces a defining relative clause describing a person.

examples.en: The gardener's assistant who helped Owen works at the history museum.
examples.vi: phụ tá làm vườn đã giúp Owen làm việc tại bảo tàng lịch sử.

common_mistake.wrong: The gardener's assistant whose helped Owen works at the history museum.
common_mistake.correct: The gardener's assistant who helped Owen works at the history museum.
common_mistake.why_vi: Who introduces a defining relative clause describing a person.

rules.heading: Rel Thing
rules.explanation_vi: Which (or that) introduces a defining relative clause about a thing.

examples.en: The report on charity donations which Iris submitted yesterday is on the desk.
examples.vi: Bản báo cáo mà Iris nộp hôm qua đang ở trên bàn.

common_mistake.wrong: The report on charity donations who Iris submitted yesterday is on the desk.
common_mistake.correct: The report on charity donations which Iris submitted yesterday is on the desk.
common_mistake.why_vi: Which (or that) introduces a defining relative clause about a thing.

rules.heading: Rel Possession
rules.explanation_vi: Whose + noun indicates possession.

examples.en: The volunteer whose work on patient records was recognized received an award.
examples.vi: Tình nguyện viên có công việc về hồ sơ bệnh nhân được công nhận đã nhận giải.

common_mistake.wrong: The volunteer who work on patient records was recognized received an award.
common_mistake.correct: The volunteer whose work on patient records was recognized received an award.
common_mistake.why_vi: Whose + noun indicates possession.

rules.heading: Rel Place
rules.explanation_vi: Where introduces a defining clause of place.

examples.en: The building where the dentist works is near the seaside café.
examples.vi: Tòa nhà nơi nha sĩ làm việc ở gần quán cà phê ven biển.

common_mistake.wrong: The building who the dentist works is near the seaside café.
common_mistake.correct: The building where the dentist works is near the seaside café.
common_mistake.why_vi: Where introduces a defining clause of place.

rules.heading: Rel Time
rules.explanation_vi: When introduces a defining clause of time.

examples.en: The day when the firefighter joined the team was unusually cold.
examples.vi: Ngày lính cứu hỏa gia nhập nhóm trời rất lạnh.

common_mistake.wrong: The day who the firefighter joined the team was unusually cold.
common_mistake.correct: The day when the firefighter joined the team was unusually cold.
common_mistake.why_vi: When introduces a defining clause of time.

rules.heading: Rel Subject Person
rules.explanation_vi: Who is a relative pronoun for a person in subject position.

examples.en: The florist who trained our new staff recently received an award.
examples.vi: người bán hoa đã đào tạo nhân viên mới gần đây nhận được một giải thưởng.

common_mistake.wrong: The florist whose trained our new staff recently received an award.
common_mistake.correct: The florist who trained our new staff recently received an award.
common_mistake.why_vi: Who is a relative pronoun for a person in subject position.

rules.heading: Rel Subject Thing
rules.explanation_vi: Which introduces a defining relative clause for a thing; that is also possible.

examples.en: The equipment for guest feedback which was delivered this morning belongs to Kai.
examples.vi: Thiết bị cho phản hồi khách hàng được giao sáng nay thuộc về Kai.

common_mistake.wrong: The equipment for guest feedback who was delivered this morning belongs to Kai.
common_mistake.correct: The equipment for guest feedback which was delivered this morning belongs to Kai.
common_mistake.why_vi: Which introduces a defining relative clause for a thing; that is also possible.

rules.heading: Rel Plural Possession
rules.explanation_vi: Whose + noun signals possession.

examples.en: The students whose projects about restaurant kitchens won the competition were invited to the sports centre.
examples.vi: Học sinh có dự án về bếp nhà hàng chiến thắng được mời đến trung tâm thể thao.

common_mistake.wrong: The students which projects about restaurant kitchens won the competition were invited to the sports centre.
common_mistake.correct: The students whose projects about restaurant kitchens won the competition were invited to the sports centre.
common_mistake.why_vi: Whose + noun signals possession.

misconceptions.wrong: The gardener's assistant whose helped Owen works at the history museum.
misconceptions.correct: The gardener's assistant who helped Owen works at the history museum.
misconceptions.why_vi: Who introduces a defining relative clause describing a person.

misconceptions.wrong: The report on charity donations who Iris submitted yesterday is on the desk.
misconceptions.correct: The report on charity donations which Iris submitted yesterday is on the desk.
misconceptions.why_vi: Which (or that) introduces a defining relative clause about a thing.

misconceptions.wrong: The volunteer who work on patient records was recognized received an award.
misconceptions.correct: The volunteer whose work on patient records was recognized received an award.
misconceptions.why_vi: Whose + noun indicates possession.

misconceptions.wrong: The building who the dentist works is near the seaside café.
misconceptions.correct: The building where the dentist works is near the seaside café.
misconceptions.why_vi: Where introduces a defining clause of place.

misconceptions.wrong: The day who the firefighter joined the team was unusually cold.
misconceptions.correct: The day when the firefighter joined the team was unusually cold.
misconceptions.why_vi: When introduces a defining clause of time.

exception_notes_vi: Who/which thường thay thế được bằng that trong mệnh đề xác định; câu điền được ghi accepted_answers.
Whose theo sau trực tiếp bởi danh từ.
Where/when có thể diễn đạt tương đương bằng giới từ + which, nhưng không hoàn toàn hoán đổi tùy cấu trúc.
learning_steps_vi: Đọc quy tắc và ví dụ song ngữ, chỉ ra dấu hiệu quyết định đáp án.
Luyện 20 câu có phản hồi ngay.
Tự làm 30 câu không xem đáp án trước.
Làm 15 câu Mastery độc lập; dành 15 câu riêng cho Spaced Review.

learn.title: Non-defining Relative Clauses
objectives_vi: Nhận diện và hiểu các cấu trúc trong bài Non-defining Relative Clauses.
Chọn cấu trúc đúng theo dấu hiệu ngữ cảnh, không học thuộc từ đơn lẻ.
Phát hiện và sửa những lỗi thường gặp ở các dạng Guided, Independent và Mastery.

rules.heading: Nondef Person
rules.explanation_vi: Non-defining who adds information about a person; do not use that.

examples.en: Owen, who works at the history museum, is speaking today about storage doors.
examples.vi: Owen, người làm ở bảo tàng lịch sử, phát biểu về cửa kho hôm nay.

common_mistake.wrong: Owen, which works at the history museum, is speaking today about storage doors.
common_mistake.correct: Owen, who works at the history museum, is speaking today about storage doors.
common_mistake.why_vi: Non-defining who adds information about a person; do not use that.

rules.heading: Nondef Thing
rules.explanation_vi: Non-defining which adds detail about a thing; that is not permitted.

examples.en: The report about outgoing letters, which arrived yesterday, is now on display.
examples.vi: Báo cáo về những lá thư gửi đi, đến hôm qua, đang được trưng bày.

common_mistake.wrong: The report about outgoing letters, who arrived yesterday, is now on display.
common_mistake.correct: The report about outgoing letters, which arrived yesterday, is now on display.
common_mistake.why_vi: Non-defining which adds detail about a thing; that is not permitted.

rules.heading: Nondef Whose
rules.explanation_vi: Whose marks possession in a non-defining clause.

examples.en: Liam, whose sibling teaches classes about old magazines, moved abroad.
examples.vi: Liam, người có anh/chị/em dạy về các tạp chí cũ, đã ra nước ngoài.

common_mistake.wrong: Liam, which sibling teaches classes about old magazines, moved abroad.
common_mistake.correct: Liam, whose sibling teaches classes about old magazines, moved abroad.
common_mistake.why_vi: Whose marks possession in a non-defining clause.

rules.heading: Nondef Where
rules.explanation_vi: Where adds location information in a non-defining relative clause.

examples.en: The seaside café, where the editor presented research on the travel guide, has reopened.
examples.vi: Quán cà phê ven biển, nơi biên tập viên trình bày nghiên cứu về cẩm nang du lịch, đã mở cửa lại.

common_mistake.wrong: The seaside café, which the editor presented research on the travel guide, has reopened.
common_mistake.correct: The seaside café, where the editor presented research on the travel guide, has reopened.
common_mistake.why_vi: Where adds location information in a non-defining relative clause.

rules.heading: Nondef When
rules.explanation_vi: When gives extra information about a date.

examples.en: Monday, when the committee reviewing ceiling lights meets, is a public holiday.
examples.vi: Thứ Hai, khi hội đồng xem xét đèn trần họp, là ngày lễ.

common_mistake.wrong: Monday, where the committee reviewing ceiling lights meets, is a public holiday.
common_mistake.correct: Monday, when the committee reviewing ceiling lights meets, is a public holiday.
common_mistake.why_vi: When gives extra information about a date.

rules.heading: Nondef Who 2
rules.explanation_vi: Who in a non-defining clause is not omitted or replaced by that.

examples.en: Aisha, who worked with the museum curator on ancient coins, received a thank-you letter.
examples.vi: Aisha, người làm việc cùng người quản lý bảo tàng về các đồng xu cổ, nhận được thư cảm ơn.

common_mistake.wrong: Aisha, that worked with the museum curator on ancient coins, received a thank-you letter.
common_mistake.correct: Aisha, who worked with the museum curator on ancient coins, received a thank-you letter.
common_mistake.why_vi: Who in a non-defining clause is not omitted or replaced by that.

rules.heading: Nondef Object Which
rules.explanation_vi: Non-defining object relative requires which, not omission.

examples.en: The report on meeting rooms, which we discussed yesterday, needs revision.
examples.vi: Báo cáo về các phòng họp, mà chúng tôi trao đổi hôm qua, cần chỉnh sửa.

common_mistake.wrong: The report on meeting rooms, that we discussed yesterday, needs revision.
common_mistake.correct: The report on meeting rooms, which we discussed yesterday, needs revision.
common_mistake.why_vi: Non-defining object relative requires which, not omission.

rules.heading: Nondef Possession
rules.explanation_vi: Whose expresses possession in a non-defining relative clause.

examples.en: Sofia, whose presentation about stage costumes impressed the panel, won first prize.
examples.vi: Sofia, có bài thuyết trình về trang phục sân khấu gây ấn tượng, đã giành giải nhất.

common_mistake.wrong: Sofia, that presentation about stage costumes impressed the panel, won first prize.
common_mistake.correct: Sofia, whose presentation about stage costumes impressed the panel, won first prize.
common_mistake.why_vi: Whose expresses possession in a non-defining relative clause.

misconceptions.wrong: Owen, which works at the history museum, is speaking today about storage doors.
misconceptions.correct: Owen, who works at the history museum, is speaking today about storage doors.
misconceptions.why_vi: Non-defining who adds information about a person; do not use that.

misconceptions.wrong: The report about outgoing letters, who arrived yesterday, is now on display.
misconceptions.correct: The report about outgoing letters, which arrived yesterday, is now on display.
misconceptions.why_vi: Non-defining which adds detail about a thing; that is not permitted.

misconceptions.wrong: Liam, which sibling teaches classes about old magazines, moved abroad.
misconceptions.correct: Liam, whose sibling teaches classes about old magazines, moved abroad.
misconceptions.why_vi: Whose marks possession in a non-defining clause.

misconceptions.correct: The seaside café, where the editor presented research on the travel guide, has reopened.
misconceptions.why_vi: Where adds location information in a non-defining relative clause.

misconceptions.wrong: Monday, where the committee reviewing ceiling lights meets, is a public holiday.
misconceptions.correct: Monday, when the committee reviewing ceiling lights meets, is a public holiday.
misconceptions.why_vi: When gives extra information about a date.

learn.title: Relative Pronouns & Omission
objectives_vi: Nhận diện và hiểu các cấu trúc trong bài Relative Pronouns & Omission.
Chọn cấu trúc đúng theo dấu hiệu ngữ cảnh, không học thuộc từ đơn lẻ.
Phát hiện và sửa những lỗi thường gặp ở các dạng Guided, Independent và Mastery.

rules.heading: Subject No Omit
rules.explanation_vi: A subject relative pronoun is not omissible in a defining relative clause.

examples.en: In “The bicycle mechanic who led the tour was friendly”, “who” cannot be omitted because it is the clause subject.
examples.vi: Who làm chủ ngữ trong mệnh đề quan hệ nên không lược bỏ được.

common_mistake.wrong: In “The bicycle mechanic who led the tour was friendly”, “who” can be omitted because it is the clause subject.
common_mistake.correct: In “The bicycle mechanic who led the tour was friendly”, “who” cannot be omitted because it is the clause subject.
common_mistake.why_vi: A subject relative pronoun is not omissible in a defining relative clause.

rules.heading: Object Omit
rules.explanation_vi: An object relative pronoun may be omitted from a defining clause.

examples.en: In “The market seller who Iris met was friendly”, “who” can be omitted because it is the object.
examples.vi: Who làm tân ngữ trong mệnh đề xác định nên có thể bỏ.

common_mistake.wrong: In “The market seller who Iris met was friendly”, “who” cannot be omitted because it is the object.
common_mistake.correct: In “The market seller who Iris met was friendly”, “who” can be omitted because it is the object.
common_mistake.why_vi: An object relative pronoun may be omitted from a defining clause.

rules.heading: Thing Object Omit
rules.explanation_vi: Which as an object in a defining relative clause can be omitted.

examples.en: In “The report on event posters which Liam edited is ready”, “which” can be omitted because it is the object.
examples.vi: Which làm tân ngữ trong mệnh đề xác định nên có thể bỏ.

common_mistake.wrong: In “The report on event posters which Liam edited is ready”, “which” cannot be omitted because it is the object.
common_mistake.correct: In “The report on event posters which Liam edited is ready”, “which” can be omitted because it is the object.
common_mistake.why_vi: Which as an object in a defining relative clause can be omitted.

rules.heading: Thing Subject No Omit
rules.explanation_vi: Subject relative which cannot be omitted.

examples.en: In “The report on hotel reservations which arrived yesterday is ready”, “which” cannot be omitted because it is the subject.
examples.vi: Which làm chủ ngữ trong mệnh đề quan hệ nên không thể bỏ.

common_mistake.wrong: In “The report on hotel reservations which arrived yesterday is ready”, “which” can be omitted because it is the subject.
common_mistake.correct: In “The report on hotel reservations which arrived yesterday is ready”, “which” cannot be omitted because it is the subject.
common_mistake.why_vi: Subject relative which cannot be omitted.

rules.heading: Nondef No Omit
rules.explanation_vi: Non-defining relative pronouns cannot be omitted.

examples.en: In “Adam, who teaches classes about medicine bottles, has moved away”, “who” cannot be omitted because the clause is non-defining.
examples.vi: Không được lược bỏ who trong mệnh đề quan hệ không xác định.

common_mistake.wrong: In “Adam, who teaches classes about medicine bottles, has moved away”, “who” can be omitted because the clause is non-defining.
common_mistake.correct: In “Adam, who teaches classes about medicine bottles, has moved away”, “who” cannot be omitted because the clause is non-defining.
common_mistake.why_vi: Non-defining relative pronouns cannot be omitted.

rules.heading: Whose No Omit
rules.explanation_vi: Whose + noun cannot simply be omitted from this clause.

examples.en: In “The designer whose drawings of the final scene won are famous”, “whose” cannot be omitted because it shows possession.
examples.vi: Whose chỉ sở hữu nên không được lược bỏ.

common_mistake.wrong: In “The designer whose drawings of the final scene won are famous”, “whose” can be omitted because it shows possession.
common_mistake.correct: In “The designer whose drawings of the final scene won are famous”, “whose” cannot be omitted because it shows possession.
common_mistake.why_vi: Whose + noun cannot simply be omitted from this clause.

rules.heading: Where Restructure
rules.explanation_vi: Where is a relative adverb; omission requires restructuring (works at).

examples.en: In “The place where the hospital clerk works is quiet”, “where” cannot simply be omitted without restructuring the sentence.
examples.vi: Không thể bỏ where mà không sửa lại cấu trúc.

common_mistake.wrong: In “The place where the hospital clerk works is quiet”, “where” can always be omitted without restructuring the sentence.
common_mistake.correct: In “The place where the hospital clerk works is quiet”, “where” cannot simply be omitted without restructuring the sentence.
common_mistake.why_vi: Where is a relative adverb; omission requires restructuring (works at).

rules.heading: That Object Omit
rules.explanation_vi: An object relative that can be omitted in a defining clause.

examples.en: In “The book about podcast recordings that Sofia borrowed was expensive”, “that” can be omitted because it functions as the object.
examples.vi: That làm tân ngữ trong mệnh đề xác định nên có thể bỏ.

common_mistake.correct: In “The book about podcast recordings that Sofia borrowed was expensive”, “that” can be omitted because it functions as the object.
common_mistake.why_vi: An object relative that can be omitted in a defining clause.

exception_notes_vi: Đại từ quan hệ làm tân ngữ của mệnh đề xác định có thể lược bỏ; làm chủ ngữ thì không.

learn.title: Reported Statements
objectives_vi: Nhận diện và hiểu các cấu trúc trong bài Reported Statements.
Chọn cấu trúc đúng theo dấu hiệu ngữ cảnh, không học thuộc từ đơn lẻ.
Phát hiện và sửa những lỗi thường gặp ở các dạng Guided, Independent và Mastery.

rules.heading: Backshift Be
rules.explanation_vi: Am in a direct statement normally becomes was when the statement is reported with said.

examples.en: Yesterday, Owen said, “I am responsible for the report on interview clips.” Later, Owen said that he was responsible for the report on interview clips.
examples.vi: Hôm qua Owen nói rằng mình phụ trách báo cáo về các đoạn phỏng vấn.

common_mistake.wrong: Yesterday, Owen said, “I am responsible for the report on interview clips.” Later, Owen said that he am responsible for the report on interview clips.
common_mistake.correct: Yesterday, Owen said, “I am responsible for the report on interview clips.” Later, Owen said that he was responsible for the report on interview clips.
common_mistake.why_vi: Am in a direct statement normally becomes was when the statement is reported with said.

rules.heading: Backshift Will
rules.explanation_vi: Will usually shifts to would after a past reporting verb.

examples.en: Iris said yesterday, “I will check the report on birthday cakes.” Later, a colleague said that Iris would check the report on birthday cakes.
examples.vi: Iris nói hôm qua rằng mình sẽ kiểm tra báo cáo về bánh sinh nhật.

common_mistake.wrong: Iris said yesterday, “I will check the report on birthday cakes.” Later, a colleague said that Iris will check the report on birthday cakes.
common_mistake.correct: Iris said yesterday, “I will check the report on birthday cakes.” Later, a colleague said that Iris would check the report on birthday cakes.
common_mistake.why_vi: Will usually shifts to would after a past reporting verb.

rules.heading: Backshift Present Perfect
rules.explanation_vi: Present perfect can backshift to past perfect after said.

examples.en: Liam said, “I have finished the report on warm meals.” The team reported that Liam had finished the report on warm meals.
examples.vi: Liam nói mình đã hoàn thành báo cáo về các suất ăn nóng; nhóm thuật lại rằng việc ấy đã xong.

common_mistake.wrong: Liam said, “I have finished the report on warm meals.” The team reported that Liam has finished the report on warm meals.
common_mistake.correct: Liam said, “I have finished the report on warm meals.” The team reported that Liam had finished the report on warm meals.
common_mistake.why_vi: Present perfect can backshift to past perfect after said.

rules.heading: Backshift Can
rules.explanation_vi: Can often becomes could in past reported speech.

examples.en: Hana said, “I can handle the report on flight plans.” The memo reported that Hana could handle the report on flight plans.
examples.vi: Hana nói mình có thể xử lý báo cáo về kế hoạch bay; biên bản thuật lại như vậy.

common_mistake.wrong: Hana said, “I can handle the report on flight plans.” The memo reported that Hana can handle the report on flight plans.
common_mistake.correct: Hana said, “I can handle the report on flight plans.” The memo reported that Hana could handle the report on flight plans.
common_mistake.why_vi: Can often becomes could in past reported speech.

rules.heading: Backshift Continuous
rules.explanation_vi: Present continuous can backshift to past continuous: was/were + V-ing.

examples.en: Adam said, “I am checking the report on monthly invoices.” The assistant reported that Adam was checking the report on monthly invoices.
examples.vi: Adam nói mình đang kiểm tra báo cáo về các hóa đơn hằng tháng; trợ lý đã thuật lại lời đó.

common_mistake.wrong: Adam said, “I am checking the report on monthly invoices.” The assistant reported that Adam is checking the report on monthly invoices.
common_mistake.correct: Adam said, “I am checking the report on monthly invoices.” The assistant reported that Adam was checking the report on monthly invoices.
common_mistake.why_vi: Present continuous can backshift to past continuous: was/were + V-ing.

rules.heading: Shift Time
rules.explanation_vi: Yesterday usually changes to the previous day / the day before in later reporting.

examples.en: Aisha said on Monday, “I finished the report on excavation findings yesterday.” Reporting it on Tuesday, the secretary wrote that Aisha had finished the report on excavation findings the previous day.
examples.vi: Aisha nói mình đã hoàn thành báo cáo về các phát hiện khai quật hôm trước.

common_mistake.wrong: Aisha said on Monday, “I finished the report on excavation findings yesterday.” Reporting it on Tuesday, the secretary wrote that Aisha had finished the report on excavation findings tomorrow.
common_mistake.correct: Aisha said on Monday, “I finished the report on excavation findings yesterday.” Reporting it on Tuesday, the secretary wrote that Aisha had finished the report on excavation findings the previous day.
common_mistake.why_vi: Yesterday usually changes to the previous day / the day before in later reporting.

rules.heading: Backshift Obligation
rules.explanation_vi: Have to commonly becomes had to in a past-time report.

examples.en: Kai said, “I have to revise the report on student meetings.” The report stated that Kai had to revise the report on student meetings.
examples.vi: Kai nói mình phải sửa báo cáo về các buổi gặp học sinh; báo cáo đã thuật lại lời đó.

common_mistake.wrong: Kai said, “I have to revise the report on student meetings.” The report stated that Kai has to revise the report on student meetings.
common_mistake.correct: Kai said, “I have to revise the report on student meetings.” The report stated that Kai had to revise the report on student meetings.
common_mistake.why_vi: Have to commonly becomes had to in a past-time report.

rules.heading: Backshift May
rules.explanation_vi: May often changes to might in past reported speech.

examples.en: Sofia said, “I may change the report on basic first-aid techniques.” The assistant reported that Sofia might change the report on basic first-aid techniques.
examples.vi: Sofia nói mình có thể sẽ thay đổi báo cáo về các kỹ thuật sơ cứu cơ bản; trợ lý thuật lại bằng might.

common_mistake.wrong: Sofia said, “I may change the report on basic first-aid techniques.” The assistant reported that Sofia may to change the report on basic first-aid techniques.
common_mistake.correct: Sofia said, “I may change the report on basic first-aid techniques.” The assistant reported that Sofia might change the report on basic first-aid techniques.
common_mistake.why_vi: May often changes to might in past reported speech.

misconceptions.correct: Yesterday, Owen said, “I am responsible for the report on interview clips.” Later, Owen said that he was responsible for the report on interview clips.
misconceptions.why_vi: Am in a direct statement normally becomes was when the statement is reported with said.

exception_notes_vi: Khi điều được tường thuật vẫn đúng, đôi lúc không cần backshift; bài tập nêu khung tường thuật quá khứ điển hình.
Yesterday → the previous day / the day before theo thời điểm thuật lại.

learning_steps_vi: Đọc quy tắc và ví dụ song ngữ, chỉ ra dấu hiệu quyết định đáp án.

questions.prompt_en: Kai said, “I have to revise the report on dental equipment.” The report stated that Kai _____ revise the report on dental equipment.
questions.instruction_vi: Điền cụm từ chính xác vào chỗ trống theo ngữ cảnh.
questions.translation_vi: Kai nói mình phải sửa báo cáo về thiết bị nha khoa; báo cáo đã thuật lại lời đó.
questions.explanation_correct_vi: Have to commonly becomes had to in a past-time report.
questions.feedback_on_wrong_vi: Chú ý nhóm lỗi BACKSHIFT_OBLIGATION: Have to commonly becomes had to in a past-time report.
questions.context_en_teacher_only: Kai said, “I have to revise the report on dental equipment.” The report stated that Kai had to revise the report on dental equipment.

questions.prompt_en: Sofia said, “I may change the report on emergency exits.” The assistant reported that Sofia _____ change the report on emergency exits.
questions.instruction_vi: Điền cụm từ chính xác vào chỗ trống theo ngữ cảnh.
questions.translation_vi: Sofia nói mình có thể sẽ thay đổi báo cáo về các lối thoát hiểm; trợ lý thuật lại bằng might.
questions.explanation_correct_vi: May often changes to might in past reported speech.
questions.feedback_on_wrong_vi: Chú ý nhóm lỗi BACKSHIFT_MAY: May often changes to might in past reported speech.
questions.context_en_teacher_only: Sofia said, “I may change the report on emergency exits.” The assistant reported that Sofia might change the report on emergency exits.

questions.prompt_en: Yesterday, Leo said, “I am responsible for the report on birthday bouquets.” Later, Leo said that he _____ responsible for the report on birthday bouquets.
questions.instruction_vi: Điền cụm từ chính xác vào chỗ trống theo ngữ cảnh.
questions.translation_vi: Hôm qua Leo nói rằng mình phụ trách báo cáo về các bó hoa sinh nhật.
questions.explanation_correct_vi: Am in a direct statement normally becomes was when the statement is reported with said.
questions.feedback_on_wrong_vi: Chú ý nhóm lỗi BACKSHIFT_BE: Am in a direct statement normally becomes was when the statement is reported with said.
questions.context_en_teacher_only: Yesterday, Leo said, “I am responsible for the report on birthday bouquets.” Later, Leo said that he was responsible for the report on birthday bouquets.

questions.prompt_en: Nora said yesterday, “I will check the report on guest feedback.” Later, a colleague said that Nora _____ check the report on guest feedback.

questions.feedback_on_wrong_vi: Chú ý nhóm lỗi BACKSHIFT_WILL: Will usually shifts to would after a past reporting verb.
questions.context_en_teacher_only: Nora said yesterday, “I will check the report on guest feedback.” Later, a colleague said that Nora would check the report on guest feedback.

questions.prompt_en: Correct only “can” in this sentence: “Maya said, “I can handle the report on air pollution levels.” The memo reported that Maya can handle the report on air pollution levels.”

questions.explanation_correct_vi: Can often becomes could in past reported speech.
questions.feedback_on_wrong_vi: Chú ý nhóm lỗi BACKSHIFT_CAN: Can often becomes could in past reported speech.
questions.context_en_teacher_only: Maya said, “I can handle the report on air pollution levels.” The memo reported that Maya could handle the report on air pollution levels.

option_rationales_vi.could: Can often becomes could in past reported speech.
option_rationales_vi.can: “can” không thực hiện đúng chuyển thì, đại từ hoặc trật tự từ từ lời nói trực tiếp sang lời tường thuật ở ngữ cảnh này.
option_rationales_vi.could to: “could to” thêm to không cần thiết vào động từ khuyết thiếu/cấu trúc tường thuật.
option_rationales_vi.was can: “was can” không thực hiện đúng chuyển thì, đại từ hoặc trật tự từ từ lời nói trực tiếp sang lời tường thuật ở ngữ cảnh này.

questions.explanation_correct_vi: Present continuous can backshift to past continuous: was/were + V-ing.
questions.feedback_on_wrong_vi: Chú ý nhóm lỗi BACKSHIFT_CONTINUOUS: Present continuous can backshift to past continuous: was/were + V-ing.
questions.context_en_teacher_only: Ethan said, “I am checking the report on training sessions.” The assistant reported that Ethan was checking the report on training sessions.

option_rationales_vi.has checking: “has checking” không thực hiện đúng chuyển thì, đại từ hoặc trật tự từ từ lời nói trực tiếp sang lời tường thuật ở ngữ cảnh này.
option_rationales_vi.was check: “was check” không thực hiện đúng chuyển thì, đại từ hoặc trật tự từ từ lời nói trực tiếp sang lời tường thuật ở ngữ cảnh này.

learn.title: Reported Questions
objectives_vi: Nhận diện và hiểu các cấu trúc trong bài Reported Questions.
Chọn cấu trúc đúng theo dấu hiệu ngữ cảnh, không học thuộc từ đơn lẻ.
Phát hiện và sửa những lỗi thường gặp ở các dạng Guided, Independent và Mastery.

rules.heading: Yes No Whether
rules.explanation_vi: Reported yes/no questions use if or whether + statement word order.

examples.en: “Do you need the report on borrowed books?” Owen asked me. I reported that Owen asked me whether I needed the report on borrowed books.
examples.vi: Owen hỏi tôi có cần báo cáo về những cuốn sách đã mượn hay không.

common_mistake.wrong: “Do you need the report on borrowed books?” Owen asked me. I reported that Owen asked me what I needed the report on borrowed books.
common_mistake.correct: “Do you need the report on borrowed books?” Owen asked me. I reported that Owen asked me whether I needed the report on borrowed books.
common_mistake.why_vi: Reported yes/no questions use if or whether + statement word order.

rules.heading: Reported Wh Backshift
rules.explanation_vi: Reported wh-question: where + subject + past perfect; no did inversion.

examples.en: “Where did you leave the report on neighborhood murals?” Iris asked me. Iris asked me where I had left the report on neighborhood murals.
examples.vi: Iris hỏi tôi đã để báo cáo về các bức tranh tường trong khu phố ở đâu.

common_mistake.wrong: “Where did you leave the report on neighborhood murals?” Iris asked me. Iris asked me where I did leave the report on neighborhood murals.
common_mistake.correct: “Where did you leave the report on neighborhood murals?” Iris asked me. Iris asked me where I had left the report on neighborhood murals.
common_mistake.why_vi: Reported wh-question: where + subject + past perfect; no did inversion.

rules.heading: Reported Future Question
rules.explanation_vi: A future reported question normally shifts will to would.

examples.en: “When will the team review the report on vegetable soup?” Liam asked. Liam asked when the team would review the report on vegetable soup.
examples.vi: Liam hỏi khi nào nhóm sẽ xem lại báo cáo về súp rau củ.

common_mistake.wrong: “When will the team review the report on vegetable soup?” Liam asked. Liam asked when the team will to review the report on vegetable soup.
common_mistake.correct: “When will the team review the report on vegetable soup?” Liam asked. Liam asked when the team would review the report on vegetable soup.
common_mistake.why_vi: A future reported question normally shifts will to would.

rules.heading: Reported Why
rules.explanation_vi: Reported wh-question uses subject + past continuous, not inverted word order.

examples.en: “Why are you changing the report on leaking pipes?” Hana asked me. Hana asked me why I was changing the report on leaking pipes.
examples.vi: Hana hỏi vì sao tôi đang thay đổi báo cáo về các ống nước rò rỉ.

common_mistake.wrong: “Why are you changing the report on leaking pipes?” Hana asked me. Hana asked me why I were changing the report on leaking pipes.
common_mistake.correct: “Why are you changing the report on leaking pipes?” Hana asked me. Hana asked me why I was changing the report on leaking pipes.
common_mistake.why_vi: Reported wh-question uses subject + past continuous, not inverted word order.

rules.heading: Reported Perfect Q
rules.explanation_vi: Past reporting of a present perfect question commonly uses had + V3.

examples.en: “Have you signed the report on wooden shelves?” Adam asked me. Adam asked me if I had signed the report on wooden shelves.
examples.vi: Adam hỏi tôi đã ký báo cáo về những chiếc kệ gỗ chưa.

common_mistake.wrong: “Have you signed the report on wooden shelves?” Adam asked me. Adam asked me if I have signed the report on wooden shelves.
common_mistake.correct: “Have you signed the report on wooden shelves?” Adam asked me. Adam asked me if I had signed the report on wooden shelves.
common_mistake.why_vi: Past reporting of a present perfect question commonly uses had + V3.

rules.heading: Reported Can
rules.explanation_vi: Can becomes could in reported questions with a past reporting verb.

examples.en: “Can we share the report on grammar rules?” Aisha asked. The minutes said that Aisha asked whether they could share the report on grammar rules.
examples.vi: Aisha hỏi nhóm có thể chia sẻ báo cáo về các quy tắc ngữ pháp không.

common_mistake.wrong: “Can we share the report on grammar rules?” Aisha asked. The minutes said that Aisha asked whether they could to share the report on grammar rules.
common_mistake.correct: “Can we share the report on grammar rules?” Aisha asked. The minutes said that Aisha asked whether they could share the report on grammar rules.
common_mistake.why_vi: Can becomes could in reported questions with a past reporting verb.

rules.heading: Wh Statement Order
rules.explanation_vi: Indirect wh-question uses statement order; cost can remain cost as an irregular past verb.

examples.en: “How much does the report on building entrances cost?” Kai asked. Kai asked how much the report on building entrances cost.
examples.vi: Kai hỏi báo cáo về các lối vào tòa nhà có giá bao nhiêu.

common_mistake.wrong: “How much does the report on building entrances cost?” Kai asked. Kai asked how much the report on building entrances does cost.
common_mistake.correct: “How much does the report on building entrances cost?” Kai asked. Kai asked how much the report on building entrances cost.
common_mistake.why_vi: Indirect wh-question uses statement order; cost can remain cost as an irregular past verb.

rules.heading: Reported Yes No
rules.explanation_vi: Use if/whether to introduce a reported yes/no question.

examples.en: “Is the report on parent newsletters ready?” Sofia asked. Sofia asked if the report on parent newsletters was ready.
examples.vi: Sofia hỏi liệu báo cáo về bản tin cho phụ huynh đã sẵn sàng chưa.

common_mistake.wrong: “Is the report on parent newsletters ready?” Sofia asked. Sofia asked how the report on parent newsletters was ready.
common_mistake.correct: “Is the report on parent newsletters ready?” Sofia asked. Sofia asked if the report on parent newsletters was ready.
common_mistake.why_vi: Use if/whether to introduce a reported yes/no question.

misconceptions.wrong: “Do you need the report on borrowed books?” Owen asked me. I reported that Owen asked me what I needed the report on borrowed books.
misconceptions.correct: “Do you need the report on borrowed books?” Owen asked me. I reported that Owen asked me whether I needed the report on borrowed books.
misconceptions.why_vi: Reported yes/no questions use if or whether + statement word order.

misconceptions.wrong: “Where did you leave the report on neighborhood murals?” Iris asked me. Iris asked me where I did leave the report on neighborhood murals.
misconceptions.correct: “Where did you leave the report on neighborhood murals?” Iris asked me. Iris asked me where I had left the report on neighborhood murals.
misconceptions.why_vi: Reported wh-question: where + subject + past perfect; no did inversion.

misconceptions.wrong: “When will the team review the report on vegetable soup?” Liam asked. Liam asked when the team will to review the report on vegetable soup.
misconceptions.correct: “When will the team review the report on vegetable soup?” Liam asked. Liam asked when the team would review the report on vegetable soup.
misconceptions.why_vi: A future reported question normally shifts will to would.

misconceptions.wrong: “Why are you changing the report on leaking pipes?” Hana asked me. Hana asked me why I were changing the report on leaking pipes.
misconceptions.correct: “Why are you changing the report on leaking pipes?” Hana asked me. Hana asked me why I was changing the report on leaking pipes.
misconceptions.why_vi: Reported wh-question uses subject + past continuous, not inverted word order.

misconceptions.wrong: “Have you signed the report on wooden shelves?” Adam asked me. Adam asked me if I have signed the report on wooden shelves.
misconceptions.correct: “Have you signed the report on wooden shelves?” Adam asked me. Adam asked me if I had signed the report on wooden shelves.
misconceptions.why_vi: Past reporting of a present perfect question commonly uses had + V3.

exception_notes_vi: Câu gián tiếp có trật tự từ như câu kể, không đảo trợ động từ.
Whether và if thường đều chấp nhận được trong câu hỏi yes/no gián tiếp.
Wh-question và yes/no question không cùng dạng từ nối.
learning_steps_vi: Đọc quy tắc và ví dụ song ngữ, chỉ ra dấu hiệu quyết định đáp án.
Luyện 20 câu có phản hồi ngay.
Tự làm 30 câu không xem đáp án trước.
Làm 15 câu Mastery độc lập; dành 15 câu riêng cho Spaced Review.

learn.title: Reported Commands & Requests
objectives_vi: Nhận diện và hiểu các cấu trúc trong bài Reported Commands & Requests.
Chọn cấu trúc đúng theo dấu hiệu ngữ cảnh, không học thuộc từ đơn lẻ.
Phát hiện và sửa những lỗi thường gặp ở các dạng Guided, Independent và Mastery.

rules.heading: Tell To
rules.explanation_vi: Tell + person + to-infinitive for a reported instruction.

examples.en: The manager told Owen to check the report on ocean temperatures before lunch.
examples.vi: Quản lý bảo Owen kiểm tra báo cáo về nhiệt độ đại dương trước bữa trưa.

common_mistake.wrong: The manager told Owen for check the report on ocean temperatures before lunch.
common_mistake.correct: The manager told Owen to check the report on ocean temperatures before lunch.
common_mistake.why_vi: Tell + person + to-infinitive for a reported instruction.

rules.heading: Negative Command
rules.explanation_vi: Reported negative command: tell + person + not to + V.

examples.en: The supervisor told Iris not to share the report on the delivery van online.
examples.vi: Người giám sát bảo Iris không chia sẻ báo cáo về xe tải giao hàng lên mạng.

common_mistake.wrong: The supervisor told Iris to not being share the report on the delivery van online.
common_mistake.correct: The supervisor told Iris not to share the report on the delivery van online.
common_mistake.why_vi: Reported negative command: tell + person + not to + V.

rules.heading: Ask To
rules.explanation_vi: Ask + object + to-infinitive for a request.

examples.en: “Please check the report on history notes,” the assistant said. The assistant asked Liam to check the report on history notes.
examples.vi: Trợ lý nhờ Liam kiểm tra báo cáo về ghi chú môn lịch sử.

common_mistake.wrong: “Please check the report on history notes,” the assistant said. The assistant asked Liam checking the report on history notes.
common_mistake.correct: “Please check the report on history notes,” the assistant said. The assistant asked Liam to check the report on history notes.
common_mistake.why_vi: Ask + object + to-infinitive for a request.

rules.heading: Warn Not To
rules.explanation_vi: Warn + person + not to + V reports a prohibition/warning.

examples.en: “Don’t delete the report on coastal birds,” the director said. The director warned Hana not to delete the report on coastal birds.
examples.vi: Giám đốc cảnh báo Hana đừng xóa báo cáo về các loài chim ven biển.

common_mistake.wrong: “Don’t delete the report on coastal birds,” the director said. The director warned Hana to not deleting the report on coastal birds.
common_mistake.correct: “Don’t delete the report on coastal birds,” the director said. The director warned Hana not to delete the report on coastal birds.
common_mistake.why_vi: Warn + person + not to + V reports a prohibition/warning.

rules.heading: Remind To
rules.explanation_vi: Remind + person + to-infinitive for an action to remember.

examples.en: The coach reminded Adam to bring the report on chemical samples to the meeting.
examples.vi: Huấn luyện viên nhắc Adam mang báo cáo về các mẫu hóa chất đến cuộc họp.

common_mistake.wrong: The coach reminded Adam bringing the report on chemical samples to the meeting.
common_mistake.correct: The coach reminded Adam to bring the report on chemical samples to the meeting.
common_mistake.why_vi: Remind + person + to-infinitive for an action to remember.

rules.heading: Order To
rules.explanation_vi: Order + object + to-infinitive; not a gerund.

examples.en: The director ordered the team to revise the report on young rose bushes immediately.
examples.vi: Giám đốc yêu cầu nhóm sửa báo cáo về các bụi hoa hồng non ngay.

common_mistake.wrong: The director ordered the team revise the report on young rose bushes immediately.
common_mistake.correct: The director ordered the team to revise the report on young rose bushes immediately.
common_mistake.why_vi: Order + object + to-infinitive; not a gerund.

rules.heading: Request Negative
rules.explanation_vi: Negative request: asked + person + not to + V.

examples.en: “Please do not change the report on charity donations,” Kai said. Kai asked me not to change the report on charity donations.
examples.vi: Kai nhờ tôi đừng thay đổi báo cáo về các khoản quyên góp từ thiện.

common_mistake.wrong: “Please do not change the report on charity donations,” Kai said. Kai asked me not changing the report on charity donations.
common_mistake.correct: “Please do not change the report on charity donations,” Kai said. Kai asked me not to change the report on charity donations.
common_mistake.why_vi: Negative request: asked + person + not to + V.

rules.heading: Instruct To
rules.explanation_vi: Instruct + object + to-infinitive.

examples.en: “Take the report on patient records to reception,” Sofia instructed me. Sofia instructed me to take the report on patient records to reception.
examples.vi: Sofia hướng dẫn tôi mang báo cáo về hồ sơ bệnh nhân đến quầy tiếp tân.

common_mistake.wrong: “Take the report on patient records to reception,” Sofia instructed me. Sofia instructed me taking the report on patient records to reception.
common_mistake.correct: “Take the report on patient records to reception,” Sofia instructed me. Sofia instructed me to take the report on patient records to reception.
common_mistake.why_vi: Instruct + object + to-infinitive.

misconceptions.wrong: The manager told Owen for check the report on ocean temperatures before lunch.
misconceptions.correct: The manager told Owen to check the report on ocean temperatures before lunch.
misconceptions.why_vi: Tell + person + to-infinitive for a reported instruction.

misconceptions.wrong: The supervisor told Iris to not being share the report on the delivery van online.
misconceptions.correct: The supervisor told Iris not to share the report on the delivery van online.
misconceptions.why_vi: Reported negative command: tell + person + not to + V.

misconceptions.wrong: “Please check the report on history notes,” the assistant said. The assistant asked Liam checking the report on history notes.
misconceptions.correct: “Please check the report on history notes,” the assistant said. The assistant asked Liam to check the report on history notes.
misconceptions.why_vi: Ask + object + to-infinitive for a request.

misconceptions.wrong: “Don’t delete the report on coastal birds,” the director said. The director warned Hana to not deleting the report on coastal birds.
misconceptions.correct: “Don’t delete the report on coastal birds,” the director said. The director warned Hana not to delete the report on coastal birds.
misconceptions.why_vi: Warn + person + not to + V reports a prohibition/warning.

misconceptions.wrong: The coach reminded Adam bringing the report on chemical samples to the meeting.
misconceptions.correct: The coach reminded Adam to bring the report on chemical samples to the meeting.
misconceptions.why_vi: Remind + person + to-infinitive for an action to remember.

exception_notes_vi: Ask/tell/remind/warn + object + to-V thường dùng khi thuật lại mệnh lệnh/lời nhờ.
Phủ định dùng not to + V, không dùng don’t trong cấu trúc tường thuật.
Please gợi lời nhờ nhưng sắc thái ask vs tell còn phụ thuộc ngữ cảnh giao tiếp.
learning_steps_vi: Đọc quy tắc và ví dụ song ngữ, chỉ ra dấu hiệu quyết định đáp án.
Luyện 20 câu có phản hồi ngay.
Tự làm 30 câu không xem đáp án trước.
Làm 15 câu Mastery độc lập; dành 15 câu riêng cho Spaced Review.

rules.heading: Indirect Wh Order
rules.explanation_vi: Indirect question uses statement order: where + subject + verb.

examples.en: Could you tell me where the meeting is taking place near the history museum to discuss new dance steps?
examples.vi: Bạn có thể cho tôi biết cuộc họp diễn ra ở đâu gần bảo tàng lịch sử không?

common_mistake.wrong: Could you tell me where is the meeting taking place near the history museum to discuss new dance steps?
common_mistake.correct: Could you tell me where the meeting is taking place near the history museum to discuss new dance steps?
common_mistake.why_vi: Indirect question uses statement order: where + subject + verb.

rules.heading: Indirect Yes No
rules.explanation_vi: For yes/no indirect questions, use if or whether, not do-inversion.

examples.en: Do you know whether the report on wedding photographs is available today?
examples.vi: Bạn có biết hôm nay có báo cáo về ảnh đám cưới không?

common_mistake.wrong: Do you know what the report on wedding photographs is available today?
common_mistake.correct: Do you know whether the report on wedding photographs is available today?
common_mistake.why_vi: For yes/no indirect questions, use if or whether, not do-inversion.

rules.heading: Indirect Past
rules.explanation_vi: Embedded question: why + subject + past verb, without did.

examples.en: Can you explain why the staff changed the report on soil samples last week?
examples.vi: Bạn có thể giải thích vì sao nhân viên đã thay đổi báo cáo về các mẫu đất tuần trước không?

common_mistake.wrong: Can you explain why did the staff change the report on soil samples last week?
common_mistake.correct: Can you explain why the staff changed the report on soil samples last week?
common_mistake.why_vi: Embedded question: why + subject + past verb, without did.

rules.heading: Indirect How Long
rules.explanation_vi: After I wonder, use statement order, not direct-question inversion.

examples.en: I wonder how long the inspection will take at the seaside café for conference badges.
examples.vi: Tôi tự hỏi cuộc kiểm tra tại quán cà phê ven biển sẽ kéo dài bao lâu.

common_mistake.wrong: I wonder how long will the inspection take at the seaside café for conference badges.
common_mistake.correct: I wonder how long the inspection will take at the seaside café for conference badges.
common_mistake.why_vi: After I wonder, use statement order, not direct-question inversion.

rules.heading: Indirect Who Subject
rules.explanation_vi: Who can itself be the embedded question subject; no do-support is needed.

examples.en: Could you tell us who approved the report on rescued animals yesterday?
examples.vi: Bạn có thể cho biết ai đã phê duyệt báo cáo về các con vật được cứu hộ hôm qua không?

common_mistake.wrong: Could you tell us whom did approved the report on rescued animals yesterday?
common_mistake.correct: Could you tell us who approved the report on rescued animals yesterday?
common_mistake.why_vi: Who can itself be the embedded question subject; no do-support is needed.

rules.heading: Indirect When
rules.explanation_vi: Embedded wh-question uses subject + verb order.

examples.en: I would like to know when the workshop starts at the town hall to cover storage doors.
examples.vi: Tôi muốn biết khi nào buổi thực hành bắt đầu tại tòa thị chính.

common_mistake.wrong: I would like to know when does the workshop start at the town hall to cover storage doors.
common_mistake.correct: I would like to know when the workshop starts at the town hall to cover storage doors.
common_mistake.why_vi: Embedded wh-question uses subject + verb order.

rules.heading: Indirect If
rules.explanation_vi: Indirect yes/no questions are introduced by if/whether.

examples.en: Can you tell me if the report on outgoing letters has already been checked?
examples.vi: Bạn cho tôi biết báo cáo về những lá thư gửi đi đã được kiểm tra chưa?

common_mistake.wrong: Can you tell me who the report on outgoing letters has already been checked?
common_mistake.correct: Can you tell me if the report on outgoing letters has already been checked?
common_mistake.why_vi: Indirect yes/no questions are introduced by if/whether.

rules.heading: Indirect Whose
rules.explanation_vi: Indirect questions have statement order: whose + noun + subject + be.

examples.en: Do you know whose notes these are from the sports centre about old magazines?
examples.vi: Bạn có biết những ghi chú từ trung tâm thể thao này thuộc về ai không?

common_mistake.wrong: Do you know whose are these notes from the sports centre about old magazines?
common_mistake.correct: Do you know whose notes these are from the sports centre about old magazines?
common_mistake.why_vi: Indirect questions have statement order: whose + noun + subject + be.

exception_notes_vi: Câu hỏi gián tiếp không dùng đảo ngữ như câu hỏi trực tiếp.
If/whether dùng cho câu hỏi yes/no gián tiếp.
Who làm chủ ngữ không cần do-support ngay cả trong nhiều câu hỏi trực tiếp.
learning_steps_vi: Đọc quy tắc và ví dụ song ngữ, chỉ ra dấu hiệu quyết định đáp án.
Luyện 20 câu có phản hồi ngay.
Tự làm 30 câu không xem đáp án trước.
Làm 15 câu Mastery độc lập; dành 15 câu riêng cho Spaced Review.

learn.title: Question Tags
objectives_vi: Nhận diện và hiểu các cấu trúc trong bài Question Tags.
Chọn cấu trúc đúng theo dấu hiệu ngữ cảnh, không học thuộc từ đơn lẻ.
Phát hiện và sửa những lỗi thường gặp ở các dạng Guided, Independent và Mastery.

rules.heading: Tag Be Pos
rules.explanation_vi: Positive be-clause takes a negative tag with matching pronoun.

examples.en: Owen is responsible for the report on survey results, isn’t he?
examples.vi: Owen phụ trách báo cáo về kết quả khảo sát, phải không?

common_mistake.wrong: Owen is responsible for the report on survey results, doesn’t he?
common_mistake.correct: Owen is responsible for the report on survey results, isn’t he?
common_mistake.why_vi: Positive be-clause takes a negative tag with matching pronoun.

rules.heading: Tag Present Neg
rules.explanation_vi: Negative present simple takes positive does + pronoun.

examples.en: Iris doesn’t work at the research laboratory on homework assignments, does she?
examples.vi: Iris không làm việc ở phòng thí nghiệm, đúng không?

common_mistake.wrong: Iris doesn’t work at the research laboratory on homework assignments, doesn’t she?
common_mistake.correct: Iris doesn’t work at the research laboratory on homework assignments, does she?
common_mistake.why_vi: Negative present simple takes positive does + pronoun.

rules.heading: Tag Past Pos
rules.explanation_vi: Positive past simple takes negative didn’t + pronoun.

examples.en: Liam submitted the report on safety instructions yesterday, didn’t he?
examples.vi: Liam nộp báo cáo về hướng dẫn an toàn hôm qua, phải không?

common_mistake.wrong: Liam submitted the report on safety instructions yesterday, doesn’t he?
common_mistake.correct: Liam submitted the report on safety instructions yesterday, didn’t he?
common_mistake.why_vi: Positive past simple takes negative didn’t + pronoun.

rules.heading: Tag Perfect Neg
rules.explanation_vi: Negative present perfect takes positive has + pronoun.

examples.en: Hana hasn’t checked the report on the corridor floors yet, has she?
examples.vi: Hana vẫn chưa kiểm tra báo cáo về sàn hành lang, đúng không?

common_mistake.wrong: Hana hasn’t checked the report on the corridor floors yet, hasn’t she?
common_mistake.correct: Hana hasn’t checked the report on the corridor floors yet, has she?
common_mistake.why_vi: Negative present perfect takes positive has + pronoun.

rules.heading: Tag I Am
rules.explanation_vi: Special tag for I am is aren’t I in standard conversational English.

examples.en: I’m late for the meeting at the city park about new novels, aren’t I?
examples.vi: Tôi đến muộn cuộc họp tại công viên thành phố, phải không?

common_mistake.wrong: I’m late for the meeting at the city park about new novels, amn't I?
common_mistake.correct: I’m late for the meeting at the city park about new novels, aren’t I?
common_mistake.why_vi: Special tag for I am is aren’t I in standard conversational English.

rules.heading: Tag Lets
rules.explanation_vi: Let’s ... takes shall we? as the standard suggestion tag.

examples.en: Let’s discuss the report on bicycle gears later, shall we?
examples.vi: Chúng ta bàn về báo cáo về bộ số xe đạp sau nhé?

common_mistake.wrong: Let’s discuss the report on bicycle gears later, will you?
common_mistake.correct: Let’s discuss the report on bicycle gears later, shall we?
common_mistake.why_vi: Let’s ... takes shall we? as the standard suggestion tag.

rules.heading: Tag Imperative
rules.explanation_vi: Negative imperatives commonly take will you?

examples.en: Don’t forget to bring the report on fresh vegetables, will you?
examples.vi: Đừng quên mang báo cáo về rau củ tươi nhé?

common_mistake.wrong: Don’t forget to bring the report on fresh vegetables, do you?
common_mistake.correct: Don’t forget to bring the report on fresh vegetables, will you?
common_mistake.why_vi: Negative imperatives commonly take will you?

rules.heading: Tag Can
rules.explanation_vi: Positive can-clause takes can’t + corresponding pronoun.

examples.en: Sofia can finish the report on event posters today, can’t she?
examples.vi: Sofia có thể hoàn thành báo cáo về áp phích sự kiện hôm nay, phải không?

common_mistake.wrong: Sofia can finish the report on event posters today, doesn’t she?
common_mistake.correct: Sofia can finish the report on event posters today, can’t she?
common_mistake.why_vi: Positive can-clause takes can’t + corresponding pronoun.

misconceptions.wrong: Owen is responsible for the report on survey results, doesn’t he?
misconceptions.correct: Owen is responsible for the report on survey results, isn’t he?
misconceptions.why_vi: Positive be-clause takes a negative tag with matching pronoun.

misconceptions.correct: Iris doesn’t work at the research laboratory on homework assignments, does she?
misconceptions.why_vi: Negative present simple takes positive does + pronoun.

misconceptions.wrong: Liam submitted the report on safety instructions yesterday, doesn’t he?
misconceptions.correct: Liam submitted the report on safety instructions yesterday, didn’t he?
misconceptions.why_vi: Positive past simple takes negative didn’t + pronoun.

misconceptions.wrong: Hana hasn’t checked the report on the corridor floors yet, hasn’t she?
misconceptions.correct: Hana hasn’t checked the report on the corridor floors yet, has she?
misconceptions.why_vi: Negative present perfect takes positive has + pronoun.

misconceptions.wrong: I’m late for the meeting at the city park about new novels, amn't I?
misconceptions.correct: I’m late for the meeting at the city park about new novels, aren’t I?
misconceptions.why_vi: Special tag for I am is aren’t I in standard conversational English.

exception_notes_vi: Mệnh đề khẳng định thường đi với đuôi phủ định và ngược lại.
I am → aren’t I?; Let’s → shall we?
Câu mệnh lệnh thường có will you? nhưng sắc thái có thể thay đổi theo ngữ điệu.
learning_steps_vi: Đọc quy tắc và ví dụ song ngữ, chỉ ra dấu hiệu quyết định đáp án.
Luyện 20 câu có phản hồi ngay.
Tự làm 30 câu không xem đáp án trước.
Làm 15 câu Mastery độc lập; dành 15 câu riêng cho Spaced Review.
